title: Maharashtra weather update: Santacruz, Dahanu and Ratnagiri sizzle at 37.1 degrees Celsius, the highest in the state
text:
Maharashtra weather update: Santacruz, Dahanu and Ratnagiri record highest temperature at 37.1 degrees Celsius 
 Home / Mumbai / Mumbai News / Article / Maharashtra weather update: Santacruz, Dahanu and Ratnagiri sizzle at 37.1 degrees Celsius, the highest in the state 
 Maharashtra weather update: Santacruz, Dahanu and Ratnagiri sizzle at 37.1 degrees Celsius, the highest in the state
 Updated On: 26 October, 2026 11:16 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 The maximum temperature at Santacruz (representative of Mumbai suburbs) was 2.9 degrees above normal. Meanwhile, Mumbai city recorded a maximum temperature of 35.7 degrees Celsius, which was 2 degrees above the normal for the day
 Listen to this article : Mumbai city’s minimum temperature stood at 26.2 degrees Celsius, 1.5 degrees above normal. FILE PIC/ASHISH RAJE
 Santacruz, Dahanu and Ratnagiri recorded a maximum temperature of 37.1 degrees Celsius on Monday, making them the hottest locations among the stations listed in the India Meteorological Department’s (IMD) bulletin. Mumbai city recorded a maximum temperature of 35.7 degrees Celsius, which was 2 degrees above the normal for the day.
 The maximum temperature at Santacruz (representative of Mumbai suburbs) was 2.9 degrees above normal, while Dahanu recorded a departure of 3.6 degrees and Ratnagiri 3.7 degrees above normal.
